title: NTP Source Not Traceable to NPL or NIC
regulation_requirement: Connect to NTP Server of NIC or NPL or traceable NTP servers.
regulation_excerpt: shall connect to the Network Time Protocol (NTP) Server of National Informatics Centre (NIC) or National Physical Laboratory (NPL) or with NTP servers traceable to these NTP servers
current_state: ntp_source_corporate_endpoints = time.windows.com, ntp_source_production = Amazon Time Sync Service (169.254.169.123)
gap_description: The company's NTP sources are not traceable to NIC or NPL.
recommended_remediation: Switch to NTP servers traceable to NIC or NPL and update the configuration.

title: Log Retention Period Too Short

title: Cyber Incident Reporting SLA Exceeds Requirement
regulation_excerpt: shall mandatorily report cyber incidents as mentioned in Annexure I to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing such incidents

gap_description: The company's reporting SLA is 24 hours, exceeding the required 6 hours.
